newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Silicon Graphics falls.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Silicon Graphics falls.

text.p: Shares in Silicon Graphics Inc fell in after-hours trading after the company reported second quarter earnings and said that its shipments were below expectations, traders said.
Shares in the Mountain View, Calif., computer maker fell 1-1/4 to 26. The company reported earnings of $0.01 a share before charges against $0.30 a share for the same period a year before.
Silicon Graphics said it lost $0.07 a share after the charges. The First Call consensus estimate was for $0.00 earnings per share.
The company also it did not meet expected shipment levels for the second quarter.
PepsiCo Inc was up 1/4 to 34-1/2. Besides Silicon Graphics, the New York Stock Exchange was mostly quiet, traders said.
The exchange's first session had a volume of 63,600 shares against 12,500 on Wednesday. The second session's volume was 1.22 million shares against 1.57 million on Wednesday.
Unavailable shares were Corimon SACA, Westmoreland Coal Co and Mid-American Waste Systems Inc.
The American Stock Exchange reported no after-hours trading.
